remarks: Set on a dead end street, this home does not disappoint! A 3 bed, 3.5 bath condo with an ideal location near transportation, I-95, parkways, parks and schools. Enjoy a one car garage, plus off street parking for 2 more vehicles. Lower level provides a family room, bedroom, full bath and sliding doors to an outdoor oasis. Granite countertops atop stone built outdoor kitchenette with gas grill and pizza oven will not disappoint. Main level has gas fireplace with built-ins, hardwood flooring, a large island, stainless steel appliances, an abundance of cabinets, and flowing open floor plan. Find two bedrooms on 3rd floor each providing a full bath. Larger bedroom has two large closets. A wonderful spacious home to enjoy all of the amenities Greenwich provides.
